metadata.name: reward_distribution
metadata.description: Solana program to distribute block rewards amongst Rakurai, validator, and stakers. Staker rewards accumulate in a collection account and are distributed post-epoch using a merkle root.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claims rewards for a staker from the [RewardCollectionAccount] according to their merkle proof.

accounts.name: claim_status
docs: Status of the claim. Used to prevent the same party from claiming multiple times.

accounts.name: claimant
docs: Receiver of the funds.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer for the claim transaction.

instructions.name: claim_epoch_p2c_subscription
docs: Claim epoch fee from prepaid SOL.
Pays `min(remaining due, free prepaid)` to commission + identity and notes it.
Marks claimed when fully paid, or when `force_claim` closes with the rest as `deficit`.

instructions.name: claim_revenue
docs: Claims revenue on a **legacy** TCA/MCA (pays recorded `amount` if vault funded).
Rakurai tip vaults skip commission (tip-manager drain already took that cut).

instructions.name: claim_revenue_v1
docs: Claims revenue on a **TCAV1** vault (pays `transferred_amount`; underfund → `deficit`).
Rakurai tip vaults skip commission (tip-manager drain already took that cut).

instructions.name: clear_deficit_v1
docs: Funder deposits SOL; vault deducts up to open deficit and pays commission + validator.
Same split as `claim_revenue_v1` (Rakurai tip forces 0 commission). Partial clear OK.

instructions.name: clear_p2c_deficit
docs: Funder deposits SOL; escrow deducts up to open `deficit` and pays commission + identity.
Partial clear OK. Fully clearing deficit resets grace to Active.

instructions.name: close_claim_status
docs: Permissionless; can only be invoked once the [`RewardCollectionAccount`] has expired.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

accounts.name: claim_status
docs: The [`ClaimStatus`] account associated with the staker's pubkey is closed in this instruction, returning rent to the original payer (`claim_status_payer`).

accounts.name: claim_status_payer
docs: Account that receives the closed account's lamports.

instructions.name: close_config
docs: Closes the reward distribution config account and reclaims rent.
Only the config authority can invoke this instruction.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings to be closed.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The authority that can close the config account.

instructions.name: close_p2c_config
docs: Closes the P2C config account and reclaims rent.

instructions.name: close_p2c_subscription_account
docs: Closes P2C escrow; rent + residual to initializer. Manager only.

instructions.name: close_revenue_share_account
docs: Closes a **legacy** revenue share account (`REVENUE_SHARE`). Rent to initializer.

instructions.name: close_revenue_share_account_v1
docs: Closes a **TCAV1** revenue share account (`REVENUE_SHARE_V1`). Rent to initializer.

instructions.name: close_reward_collection_account
docs: Sends unclaimed funds to the `initializer` and closes the [`RewardCollectionAccount`],
returning rent to the validator.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

instructions.name: close_tips_and_mev_share_config
docs: Closes the tips-and-mev-share config account and reclaims rent.

instructions.name: fund_p2c_subscription
docs: Top up prepaid SOL on the P2C escrow (any funder).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Sets up the singleton [RewardDistributionConfigAccount] to store global configuration settings for Rakurai.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

accounts.name: initializer
docs: Fee payer for the initialize transaction

instructions.name: initialize_p2c_config
docs: One-time init of the P2C config singleton (defaults for `initialize_p2c_subscription_account`).

instructions.name: initialize_p2c_subscription_account
docs: Manager-only create of a prepaid P2C subscription PDA (`P2C_SUBSCRIPTION` + name + vote).
Initializes a P2C subscription escrow using [`P2CConfigAccount`] defaults.
Any payer may create; manager / record / commission / grace / capacity come from config.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent; stored as `initializer` (residual on close).

instructions.name: initialize_revenue_share_account
docs: Deprecated: use [`initialize_revenue_share_account_v1`].

instructions.name: initialize_revenue_share_account_v1
docs: Initializes a revenue share vault using [`TipsAndMevShareConfigAccount`] defaults (no RD config).
Manager/commission/epoch come from config; `record_authority` is an instruction arg (like legacy).

instructions.name: initialize_reward_collection_account
docs: Deprecated: use [`initialize_reward_collection_account_v1`].

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

instructions.name: initialize_reward_collection_account_v1
docs: Initialize a new [RewardCollectionAccount] with Rakurai activation checks.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

instructions.name: initialize_tips_and_mev_share_config
docs: One-time init of the tips-and-mev-share config singleton (defaults for `initialize_revenue_share_account_v1`).

instructions.name: record_and_transfer
docs: Record attributed amount and settle SOL in one ix on TCAV1 / MCAV1 (non-Rakurai tip).
Current epoch only. Auth: `record_authority`. Payer funds the transfer (may be same signer).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the settle transfer (may equal `record_authority`).

instructions.name: record_p2c_subscription
docs: Record stake snapshot and amount due for an epoch (once). Manager only.
If the ledger is full of unclaimed rows, the oldest epoch is moved into `deficit`.

instructions.name: record_revenue
docs: Records revenue for the current epoch on a **legacy** TCA/MCA (`REVENUE_SHARE`).

instructions.name: record_revenue_v1
docs: Records revenue on a **TCAV1** vault (`REVENUE_SHARE_V1`).
Rakurai tip TCAV1 also credits `transferred_amount`.
If the ledger is full of unclaimed rows, the oldest epoch is moved into `deficit`.

instructions.name: settle_revenue
docs: For non-Rakurai TCAV1 vaults: CPI system-transfer SOL into the vault, then `credit_transferred`.

instructions.name: transfer_client_commission_on_mev_commission
docs: Deducts client commission from MEV rewards earned by the validator.

instructions.name: transfer_staker_rewards
docs: Transfers staker rewards to the [RewardCollectionAccount] and client commission to commission account from `total_rewards`.
Invoked every leader turn.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Update config fields. Only the [RewardDistributionConfigAccount] authority can invoke this.
Grows legacy config accounts to the current [`RewardDistributionConfigAccount::SIZE`]
(e.g. to persist `revenue_manager_authority`) before applying updates.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

instructions.name: update_deficit
docs: Sets the cumulative `deficit` field on TCAV1. Manager authority only.

instructions.name: update_epoch_converted_to_block_reward
docs: Marks a claimed epoch ledger entry as `block_reward_converted`.
Requires entry claimed and entry flag still false.
Callable by manager, record authority, or validator identity (vote node signer).

instructions.name: update_epoch_converted_to_block_reward_v1
docs: Marks a claimed TCAV1 epoch as `block_reward_converted`.

instructions.name: update_p2c_config
docs: Updates P2C config defaults. Only the config authority can invoke this.

instructions.name: update_p2c_deficit
docs: Manager adjusts cumulative P2C deficit (manual write-off / admin).

instructions.name: update_p2c_epoch_converted_to_block_reward
docs: Marks a claimed P2C epoch as converted to block rewards.

instructions.name: update_p2c_subscription_config
docs: Manager updates commission, grace, BR flag, optional record authority.

instructions.name: update_revenue_share_config
docs: Updates revenue share config (`commission_bps`, `commission_account`, `block_reward_conversion_enabled`). Manager authority only.

instructions.name: update_revenue_share_config_v1
docs: Updates TCAV1 config. Manager authority only.

instructions.name: update_tips_and_mev_share_config
docs: Updates tips-and-mev-share config defaults. Only the config authority can invoke this.

instructions.name: update_transferred_amount
docs: Credits `transferred_amount` on TCAV1 without moving lamports.

instructions.name: upload_merkle_root
docs: Uploads a merkle root to the [RewardCollectionAccount]. Only the `merkle_root_upload_authority` can invoke this instruction.

accounts.name: config
docs: The global configuration account for Reward Distribution settings.

errors.name: AccountValidationFailure
errors.msg: Account failed validation.

errors.name: ArithmeticError
errors.msg: Encountered an arithmetic under/overflow error.

errors.name: ExceedsMaxClaim
errors.msg: The maximum number of funds to be claimed has been exceeded.

errors.name: ExceedsMaxNumNodes
errors.msg: The maximum number of claims has been exceeded.

errors.name: ExpiredRewardCollectionAccount
errors.msg: The given RewardCollectionAccount has expired.

errors.name: FundsAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: The funds for the given index and RewardCollectionAccount have already been claimed.

errors.name: InvalidProof
errors.msg: The given proof is invalid.

errors.name: MaxCommissionFeeBpsExceeded
errors.msg: Validator's commission basis points must be less than or equal to the RewardDistributionConfigAccount account's max_commission_bps.

errors.name: PrematureCloseRewardCollectionAccount
errors.msg: The given RewardCollectionAccount is not ready to be closed.

errors.name: PrematureCloseClaimStatus
errors.msg: The given ClaimStatus account is not ready to be closed.

errors.name: PrematureMerkleRootUpload
errors.msg: Must wait till at least one epoch after the reward distribution account was created to upload the merkle root.

errors.name: RootNotUploaded
errors.msg: No merkle root has been uploaded to the given RewardCollectionAccount.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized signer.

errors.name: RewardsTooLow
errors.msg: Total rewards must be greater than 0.

errors.name: InvalidClientCommissionAccount
errors.msg: Client commission account must be equal to the RewardCollectionAccount account's client_commission_account.

errors.name: MevCommissionAlreadyDeducted
errors.msg: MEV commission has already been deducted for this epoch

errors.name: InvalidRevenueName
errors.msg: Revenue label must be non-empty.

errors.name: InvalidRevenueEpochCapacity
errors.msg: Revenue ledger capacity must be between 1 and the program cap.

errors.name: EpochEntryNotFound
errors.msg: Epoch entry not found in revenue ledger.

errors.name: EpochAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Revenue for this epoch has already been claimed.

errors.name: PrematureRevenueClaim
errors.msg: Revenue can only be claimed after the epoch has ended.

errors.name: EpochNotClaimed
errors.msg: Revenue for this epoch has not been claimed yet.

errors.name: EpochAlreadyConvertedToBlockReward
errors.msg: Revenue for this epoch is already marked converted to block rewards.

errors.name: RevenueManagerNotConfigured
errors.msg: Tip/mev-share revenue manager is not configured on the reward distribution config.

errors.name: RakuraiSchedulerNotEnabled
errors.msg: Rakurai scheduler is not enabled for this validator.

errors.name: RevenueLedgerFull
errors.msg: Revenue ledger is full and all entries are unclaimed.

errors.name: InvalidRevenueShareLayout
errors.msg: Revenue share account data length does not match the expected layout for this instruction.

errors.name: P2CEpochAlreadyRecorded
errors.msg: P2C epoch fee already recorded for this epoch.

errors.name: P2CHasUnclaimedEpochs
errors.msg: P2C subscription still has unclaimed epoch entries and cannot be closed.

errors.name: NoDeficit
errors.msg: No outstanding deficit to clear.

errors.name: Deprecated
errors.msg: This instruction is deprecated; use the corresponding v1 instruction.

types.name: ClaimStatus
docs: Stores claim status for a given leaf in the Merkle tree.

fields.name: is_claimed
docs: Whether the claim was already made.

fields.name: claimant
docs: Who made the claim.

fields.name: claim_status_payer
docs: Payer of the claim status account.

fields.name: slot_claimed_at
docs: Slot when the claim was made.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount claimed.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Expiry of this claim.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: claim_status_payer
docs: Account where funds were transferred to.

fields.name: claim_status_account
docs: [ClaimStatus] account that was closed.

fields.name: reward_collection_account
docs: [RewardCollectionAccount] claimed from.

fields.name: payer
docs: User that paid for the claim, may or may not be the same as claimant.

fields.name: claimant
docs: Account that received the funds.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount of funds to distribute.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that closed the config account.

fields.name: lamports_reclaimed
docs: Amount of lamports reclaimed.

fields.name: authority
docs: Who updated it.

types.name: DeficitUpdate
docs: How the manager adjusts account-level [`RevenueShareAccountV1::deficit`].

types.name: EpochAmountEntry
docs: Legacy per-epoch attributed amount (no `transferred_amount`).

fields.name: block_reward_converted
docs: Whether this epoch's block reward conversion is complete.

types.name: EpochAmountEntryV1
docs: V1 per-epoch attributed amount with settle tracking.

fields.name: amount
docs: Accumulated via `record_revenue`.

fields.name: transferred_amount
docs: Settled SOL credited via `settle_revenue`, or auto-credited on `record_revenue` for Rakurai tip TCA.

fields.name: block_reward_converted
docs: Whether this epoch's block reward conversion is complete.

types.name: MerkleRoot
docs: Metadata about the Merkle root used for claims.

fields.name: root
docs: Merkle root hash.

fields.name: max_total_claim
docs: Max total funds claimable.

fields.name: max_num_nodes
docs: Max number of nodes that can claim.

fields.name: total_funds_claimed
docs: Funds already claimed.

fields.name: num_nodes_claimed
docs: Number of nodes that have claimed.

fields.name: merkle_root_upload_authority
docs: Who uploaded the root.

fields.name: reward_collection_account
docs: Where the root was uploaded to.

types.name: MevCommissionTransferredEvent
docs: Emitted when client commission on MEV rewards is transferred.

types.name: P2CConfigAccount
docs: Singleton defaults for P2C subscription account initialization (`initialize_p2c_subscription_account`).
Same idea as [`TipsAndMevShareConfigAccount`]: anyone may create a PSA, but manager / record /
commission / grace / ledger capacity come from this config.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authorized updater of this config.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: manager_authority
docs: Copied onto each PSA at init (claim / record / config / close).

fields.name: record_authority
docs: Copied onto each PSA at init (block-reward convert signer).

fields.name: max_epoch_entries
docs: Ledger capacity written to `max_epoch_entries` (1..=32).

fields.name: commission_bps
docs: Commission on claim (basis points).

fields.name: commission_account
docs: Receives the commission portion on claim / deficit clear.

fields.name: grace_epochs
docs: Consecutive unpaid finished epochs allowed before Suspended (0 → PSA default 2).

types.name: P2CEpochEntry
docs: Per-epoch prepaid fee row for a P2C subscription escrow.

fields.name: stake
docs: Off-chain stake snapshot used to price this epoch.

fields.name: amount_due
docs: Fee due for the epoch.

fields.name: amount_deducted
docs: Lamports paid out on claim for this epoch (`min(due, free prepaid)`).

fields.name: claimed
docs: Whether this epoch has been claimed (payout attempted).

fields.name: block_reward_converted
docs: Same lifecycle flag as revenue share after claim.

types.name: P2CLedgerEvictedToDeficitEvent
docs: Emitted when a full PSA ledger evicts an unclaimed epoch into account `deficit`.

types.name: P2CSubscriptionAccount
docs: Prepaid P2C subscription escrow per `(name, validator_vote)`.
PDA: `[P2C_SUBSCRIPTION, name, vote]`. Manager-only create.

fields.name: initializer
docs: Who paid rent; receives residual on close.

fields.name: manager_authority
docs: Creates PDA (pays rent), records epoch charges, claims, config, close.

fields.name: record_authority
docs: Optional extra signer for convert-to-block (with manager / validator identity).
Not used for `record_p2c_subscription` (manager-only).

fields.name: commission_bps
docs: e.g. 2000 = 20% to `commission_account` on claim.

fields.name: grace_epochs
docs: Consecutive unpaid finished epochs allowed before Suspended (default 2).

fields.name: deficit
docs: Cumulative shortfall closed on underfunded claims.

fields.name: paid
docs: Lamports paid this instruction.

fields.name: amount_deducted
docs: Running total paid for the epoch.

fields.name: shortfall
docs: Written to deficit only when `closed` (full pay or force_claim).

fields.name: closed
docs: Epoch marked claimed this instruction.

types.name: P2CSubscriptionLedger
docs: Epoch fee ledger for a P2C subscription escrow.

types.name: P2CSubscriptionStatus
docs: Service eligibility for P2C (clients/ops read this; program does not call out).

fields.name: is_enabled
docs: Whether the rakurai scheduler is enabled.

fields.name: proposer
docs: Who proposed this change (optional).

fields.name: validator_authority
docs: Main validator's signing authority.

fields.name: block_reward_commission_bps
docs: Validator commission on Block Rewards in basis points.

fields.name: client_commission_bps
docs: Client commission in basis points.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA.

fields.name: hash
docs: Optional hash.

types.name: RevenueKind
docs: Revenue share vault kind; included in PDA seeds after the vault base seed.

types.name: RevenueLedger
docs: Legacy per-account epoch revenue ledger.

types.name: RevenueLedgerEvictedToDeficitEvent
docs: Emitted when a full TCAV1/MCAV1 ledger evicts an unclaimed epoch into account `deficit`.

types.name: RevenueLedgerV1
docs: V1 per-account epoch revenue ledger.

types.name: RevenueShareAccount
docs: Legacy tip/mev-share revenue share vault (no `transferred_amount` / `deficit`).
PDA: `[REVENUE_SHARE, TIP|MEV_SHARE, name, vote]`.

fields.name: share_kind
docs: Tip vs mev-share; part of the PDA seeds with `name` and `validator_vote`.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8 padded label (used in PDA seeds).

fields.name: initializer
docs: Who paid to create this account; receives rent on close.

fields.name: manager_authority
docs: Claims revenue, updates config, and closes the account.

fields.name: record_authority
docs: Signs `record_revenue`.

fields.name: max_epoch_entries
docs: Max distinct epochs in `ledger`.

fields.name: commission_bps
docs: Commission on revenue claims (basis points); remainder goes to validator identity.

fields.name: commission_account
docs: Receives the commission portion on claim.

fields.name: block_reward_conversion_enabled
docs: When true, epoch entries require explicit block reward conversion via `update_epoch_converted_to_block_reward`.

types.name: RevenueShareAccountV1
docs: V1 tip/mev-share revenue share vault with settle tracking and deficit.
PDA: `[REVENUE_SHARE_V1, TIP|MEV_SHARE, name, vote]`.

fields.name: share_kind
docs: Tip vs mev-share; part of the PDA seeds with `name` and `validator_vote`.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8 padded label (used in PDA seeds).

fields.name: initializer
docs: Who paid to create this account; receives rent on close.

fields.name: manager_authority
docs: Claims revenue, updates config, and closes the account.

fields.name: record_authority
docs: Signs `record_revenue`.

fields.name: max_epoch_entries
docs: Max distinct epochs in `ledger`.

fields.name: commission_bps
docs: Commission on revenue claims (basis points); remainder goes to validator identity.

fields.name: commission_account
docs: Receives the commission portion on claim.

fields.name: block_reward_conversion_enabled
docs: When true, epoch entries require explicit block reward conversion via `update_epoch_converted_to_block_reward`.

fields.name: deficit
docs: Cumulative unpaid shortfall (`record amount - transferred` when claimed underfunded); manager can write off via `update_deficit`.

types.name: RewardCollectionAccount
docs: Stores validator reward collection account data for a given epoch.

fields.name: validator_vote_account
docs: Validator's vote account.

fields.name: merkle_root_upload_authority
docs: Authorized uploader of the Merkle root.

fields.name: merkle_root
docs: Optional Merkle root used for claims.

fields.name: creation_epoch
docs: Epoch when account was initialized.

fields.name: block_reward_commission_bps
docs: Commission on Block Rewards taken by validator specified in basis points.

fields.name: client_commission_bps
docs: Commission on block rewards & MEV tips specified in basis points; deducted if enabled.

fields.name: client_commission_account
docs: Account receiving client commission.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Epoch when claims expire.

fields.name: initializer
docs: Who initialized the account (validator identity).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: client_mev_commission_deducted
docs: Amount of MEV commission deducted by Client (if enabled).

fields.name: initializer
docs: Account where unclaimed funds were transferred to.

fields.name: reward_collection_account
docs: [RewardCollectionAccount] closed.

fields.name: expired_amount
docs: Unclaimed amount transferred.

fields.name: reward_collection_account
docs: The newly initialized reward colection account.

types.name: RewardDistributionConfigAccount
docs: Stores configuration for the reward distribution program.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authorized updater of the config.

fields.name: num_epochs_valid
docs: Number of epochs the collection account is valid.

fields.name: max_commission_bps
docs: Max allowed validator commission (basis points).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: client_commission_on_mev_commission_enabled
docs: If enabled, Client will also deduct its commission from the validator’s MEV commission.

fields.name: revenue_manager_authority
docs: Authority that may create tip/mev-share revenue share accounts and manage claims. `None` disables revenue share account creation.

types.name: StakerRewardsTransferredEvent
docs: Emitted when staker rewards are transferred after deducting commission.

types.name: TipsAndMevShareConfigAccount
docs: Singleton defaults for tip and mev-share revenue share account initialization (`init_v1`).

fields.name: authority
docs: Authorized updater of this config.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: tip_manager_authority
docs: Tip defaults (copied onto TCA at `initialize_revenue_share_account_v1`).

fields.name: tip_epoch
docs: Ledger capacity written to `max_epoch_entries` (1..=32).

fields.name: mev_share_manager_authority
docs: MevShare defaults (copied onto MCA at `initialize_revenue_share_account_v1`).

fields.name: mev_share_epoch
docs: Ledger capacity written to `max_epoch_entries` (1..=32).
